description: Find Texas Instruments email, summarize it, and draft a reply asking for clarification about next steps

steps.user_message: Find the latest email from TI, summarize it, and draft a reply asking for clarification about the next steps
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should find TI email, summarize it, and create a DRAFT (not send)
steps.agent_response: I have drafted a reply to Tim asking for more details about the next steps in the proposed research collaboration. Your draft is saved and you can review or send it when you're ready. Is there anything else you need help with?

From: tim@ti.com
To: vince.j.kaminski@enron.com
Subject: Interest in Research Collaboration
Date: 2025-10-15T15:28:00Z
Status: Unread
Body:
Dear Vince,

I hope this message finds you well. My name is Tim, and I'm part of the Advanced Research team at Texas Instruments. We've been following your recent work and are very interested in exploring potential collaboration opportunities on an upcoming research project.

If you're open to it, I'd appreciate the chance to schedule a call next week to discuss how our teams might work together.

Looking forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,
Tim
Texas Instruments
